ruleDefinitions.name: Command Line Execution with Suspicious URL and AppData Strings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that includes an URL and AppData string in the command line parameters as used by several droppers (js/vbs > powershell)

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*")))
